suppress.notes: braces <= 3.0.3 stack overflow on deeply nested brace patterns (GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm). No patched release exists upstream as of 2026-10-10. braces is a dev-only, build-time dependency here (tailwindcss -> chokidar / micromatch / fast-glob); it only ever expands the glob patterns in our own tailwind config, never user input, and is not in the production image's runtime path. Upgrade and remove this entry once braces publishes a fix.
